newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SmithKline ups capacity of Gist-b. venture.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline ups capacity of Gist-b. venture.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-brocades NV said on Thursday its British partner SmithKline Beecham will invest 43.7 million stg in its bulk penicillin facilities in Irvine, Scotland.
"This investment takes place within the framework of the joint venture with Gist-brocades NV, announced in June last year," the Dutch firm said in a statement.
SmitKline Beecham will significantly increase the production capacity and include the isolation of the penicillin nucleus 6-APA.

The investment will incorporate new technology and consequently no new jobs will be created. However, the jobs at the factory associated with penicillin manufacture will be safe-guarded as a result of this investment, Gist-brocades said.
The expansion is scheduled to be completed by the end of 1997 with production starting early in 1998.
